description: Inject TeamFlow assignments once and restore them after compaction.

hooks.command: sh -c 'root=$1; if [ ! -f "$root/hooks/user_prompt_submit.py" ]; then parent=$(dirname "$root"); root=; for candidate in "$parent"/*; do if [ -f "$candidate/hooks/user_prompt_submit.py" ]; then root=$candidate; fi; done; fi; if [ -z "$root" ]; then echo "TeamFlow hook runtime is unavailable; reinstall the plugin and restart Codex." >&2; exit 1; fi; exec uv run --project "$root" --locked python "$root/hooks/user_prompt_submit.py"' teamflow-hook "${PLUGIN_ROOT}"
